findings.title: Legacy feedback permits unauthenticated cross-owner writes and self-verification
findings.trigger: POST /api/v3/feedback or /api/v3/api/feedback with a known legacy analysis_id; token absent, invalid or belonging to another owner
findings.impact: Source artifacts are loaded without owner check, corrected values and masks can overwrite raw/input/meta/verified artifacts; reply can return analysis parameters. Unauthenticated actor is relabelled user with null actor ID; default quality flags yield verified:true.
findings.verified: Exact handler AST with synthetic storage performs6writes and returns verified:true; root confirms current live function source and public Nginx/OpenAPI route. No live mutation sent.
findings.limits: No evidence an attacker exploited it. New v4 correction workflow remains separate. Legacy retrain worker main is disabled at tools/retrain_worker.py854; do not claim automatic model training.
findings.next_action: Require real current user plus analysis ownership before loading/writing; user feedback must remain unverified until admin decision; preserve old records, add deny/owner/replay regression tests.

findings.title: Public legacy PlantNet health can echo provider API key from transport errors
findings.trigger: GET /api/v3/health/plantnet or /api/v3/health?deep=true when provider transport exception contains prepared URL with api-key query parameter
findings.impact: Raw exception text is returned publicly; requests transport errors may include credential-bearing URL.
findings.verified: Exact health AST with synthetic transporterror echoes a fake credential; root confirms current live function source matches. No real key read or leak induced.
findings.limits: Actual key exposure not observed. V4 PlantNetClient.health already sanitizes its errors.
findings.next_action: Return fixed safe error category, redact log exceptions/URLs, regression-test synthetic credential. If historical exposure confirmed, owner-managed provider-key rotation.

findings.title: Legacy report opening puts reusable session token in request URL
findings.trigger: Open a legacy v3 history report; client builds token query parameter rather than Authorization header
findings.impact: URL-bearing access logs can retain a session credential. Backend already accepts Authorization header.
evidence: server route and Docker default Uvicorn logging reviewed
findings.verified: Caller and server source confirm token query; Docker starts Uvicorn without --no-access-log. Root checked live Nginx route.
findings.limits: Real logs/tokens not read; actual production access-log redaction not established.
findings.next_action: Use Authorization header for this existing caller, remove or deprecate query-token transport compatibly, redact credential-bearing access-log fields.

findings.title: Legacy analysis decodes uploads before any application byte or pixel cap
findings.trigger: Anonymous legacy analysis receives a highly compressed large-resolution image
findings.impact: Unbounded file.read and cv2.imdecode can allocate excess memory in v3 container, affecting analysis and login. Nginx40MiB cap bounds compressed upload, not decoded pixels.
findings.verified: Source review; root confirms live route and Nginx40m. V4 bounds15MiB/25MP and has RequestLimits.
findings.limits: No large allocation/OOM or denial-of-service induced.
findings.next_action: Apply byte cap and header/pixel checks before decode; test oversized headers/images and ordinary old client uploads.

findings.title: Backend runtime cannot be reconstructed from commit alone
findings.trigger: Rebuild Docker image from same Git commit after dependencies change upstream
findings.impact: Most Python packages and Torch base are unpinned; resulting framework/ML versions can differ from verified runtime.
findings.verified: Dependency manifests/Docker instructions inspected; audit runtime explicitly recorded as local and different from historical production-compatible evidence.
findings.limits: No assertion of a specific currently vulnerable package; no dependency upgrades performed.
findings.next_action: Capture tested runtime constraints/lock with hashes, pin base images where practicable; review/test dependency updates separately.
